$comment: CI gate: `check:bundle --budget scripts/bundle-budget.json --enforce`. eagerBytes caps the code evaluated at plugin startup and moduleActivationBytes caps what each module loads when it starts; outputBytes and stylesBytes are ratchets on main.js and styles.css. Lower a limit as code shrinks; never raise one without a recorded reason.
